request: Add /computer-use-check for prerequisite checking and setup guidance without putting diagnostics back into /computer-use settings.

changes.commands.ts: Registers the standalone no-argument command, shares runCheck with the existing alias, reports missing/unverified/user-owned counts and ordered setup guidance, exposes settings validation errors, rejects unexpected arguments and reports diagnostic failures without claiming installation/repair.
changes.install.ts: Adds formatSetupGuide: supported platforms, Codex Desktop vs CLI, subscription/login user confirmation, first-time native service setup/OS permissions, Chrome extension/native host setup, recheck and independent pi switches. macOS app-bundle launch config/service paths are unverified rather than marked missing/ready.
changes.index.ts: Exports CHECK_COMMAND_NAME and formatSetupGuide without changing settings schema or runtime options.
changes.docs: English/Korean README and usage guide use /computer-use-check as the primary diagnostic entry; original alias retained.

constraints: No app-access task or browser tab is executed by the check.
No installation, service copying, native-host registration repair, feature setting change, credential read or privacy permission grant.
Successful prerequisite/file checks do not guarantee successful live automation; subscription/login and OS permissions need user confirmation.

verification.installed: Real pi print invocation: 0 missing, 1 unverified, 3 user-owned confirmations; report and guide present
verification.noApp: Empty CODEX_HOME + nonexistent macOS app override: 5 missing; app-not-found and Desktop-not-CLI setup guidance
verification.noPluginCache: Empty CODEX_HOME with installed Desktop: fallback reported explicitly; missing/unverified state retained and standard Desktop first-use setup recommended
verification.windowsSimulated: plugin-cache-missing, unverified platform checks and no-Windows-fallback guidance; no real Windows execution claimed
verification.linuxSimulated: Supported-platform guidance only; no misleading recommendation to install the local proprietary runtime on unsupported Linux
verification.tui: Actual pi 0.99.1 PTY: /computer-use-check summary/guide rendered; /computer-use still opens the simple settings view; exit 0
verification.rpc: Both /computer-use-check and /computer-use check returned report/guide with disposition handled; unexpected arguments rejected
verification.settingsIntegrity: Temporary feature flags stayed false/false after every report; the empty test CODEX_HOME remained empty
verification.package: node scripts/check-package.mjs passed for both packages; prepack/postpack passed; 52-file archive rebuilt

limits: Windows execution and cold native service launch are still unverified.
The check deliberately does not validate live account eligibility or macOS privacy grants by reading credentials/TCC data.
No live app/browser automation was run for this command-only update.
